description: Novo Nordisk announced topline SELECT (Phase 3 cardiovascular outcomes) results: semaglutide 2.4 mg reduced major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) by 20% vs placebo in adults with overweight/obesity and established CVD, no prior diabetes (17,604 participants).

source.verified: Novo Nordisk company announcement + GlobeNewswire, verified 2026-09-13

knowable_time_source: Novo Nordisk topline company announcement 2023-08-08 (the disclosure). Verified 2026-09-13.

outcome.note: Met primary endpoint (20% MACE reduction). The trial result, not a claim about the stock reaction.

disclosure_timing_source: Novo Nordisk SELECT topline company announcement 2023-08-08, released pre-market ET (Copenhagen morning; date verified, exact time not timestamp-checked).
